_meta.title: Isaiah — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from Isaiah (forgiveness, the call 'send me,' the promised child, perfect peace, renewed strength, 'fear not for I am with you,' the suffering servant, God's higher ways, the anointing to bring good news). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 23 Isaiah); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the book's devotional and prophetic high points
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.plain: 'Come now, let us settle the matter,' says the Lord. 'Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.'

verses.text: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.plain: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?' And I said, 'Here am I. Send me!'

verses.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.plain: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

verses.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.plain: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The Lord, the Lord himself, is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

verses.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.plain: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.plain: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever.

verses.text: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.plain: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.

verses.text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.plain: But those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

verses.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.plain: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

verses.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.plain: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze.

verses.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.plain: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

verses.text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.plain: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

verses.text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.plain: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.
verses.plain: 'For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways,' declares the Lord.

verses.text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.plain: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.plain: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: it will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.

verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.plain: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners.
